Commentary: Prabath Jayasuriya to Babar Azam, no run, looks to flick this away, gets an inside edge on to the pads

Prabath Jayasuriya to Babar Azam, FOUR, advances down the wicket and drills this right past the bowler. Hits the stumps at the bowler's end, deflects and races away to the fence. Straight down the ground and there was no chance for anyone to stop it
Lahiru Kumara to Azan Awais, leg byes, FOUR, short ball down the leg-side, Azan Awais looks to tuck it away, but the ball clips his thigh pad and races away to the fine leg fence
Lahiru Kumara to Azan Awais, 1 run, on a length outside off, Azan Awais knocks it into the off-side and takes a single
Lahiru Kumara to Babar Azam, THATS OUT!! Bowled!!

Lahiru Kumara to Babar Azam, out Bowled!! That's a poor leave by Babar Azam. On a length around off and it nips back in sharply. Babar tries to shoulder arms, but that hits the top off pole. Lahiru Kumara is pumped up and rightly so. Sri Lanka fighting back late in the day. Babar Azam b Lahiru Kumara 8(9) [4s-2]
Saqib Khan, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Lahiru Kumara to Saqib Khan, no run, short and quick outside off, some extra carry as Saqib Khan shoulders arms
Lahiru Kumara to Saqib Khan, no run, shapes back in sharply as Saqib Khan shoulders arms
Lahiru Kumara to Saqib Khan, no run, banged in short down the leg-side, Saqib Khan takes evasive action as the keeper gathers it by leaping across to his left
Prabath Jayasuriya to Azan Awais, 1 run, fraction short outside off, punched into the off-side for a single
Prabath Jayasuriya to Saqib Khan, no run, tossed up delivery around off, Saqib Khan knocks it down the pitch
Prabath Jayasuriya to Saqib Khan, no run, steered into the off-side by Saqib Khan
Prabath Jayasuriya to Saqib Khan, no run, flatter through the air on middle and leg, knocked down the pitch by Saqib Khan
Prabath Jayasuriya to Saqib Khan, no run, clipped off an inside edge towards short leg

Prabath Jayasuriya to Saqib Khan, 2 runs, loopy delivery around off, Saqib Khan advances down the wicket, swings across the line, and gets an outside edge over extra cover. That is certainly not what you expect from a nightwatchman
Lahiru Kumara to Azan Awais, no run, good length delivery around middle and leg, Azan Awais looks to work it away, gets hit on the pads. Appeal for an lbw, but the impact was slightly high
Lahiru Kumara to Azan Awais, no run, tad short on middle and leg, Azan Awais hops a touch and nudges it into the leg-side
The umpire is assessing the light as conditions continue to deteriorate.
Lahiru Kumara to Razaullah, no run, banged in short and at the stumps, Razaullah ducks under and lets it go

Lahiru Kumara to Razaullah, SIX, smashed, Razaullah is having some serious fun here and he's pushing Pakistan further ahead - on a length and at the stumps, Razaullah clears his front leg and has a big swipe at that, hit high on the bat, but has enough to clear the ropes at long-on
Lahiru Kumara to Razaullah, no run, Kumara shortens the length and gets it to hold its line on middle, Razaullah backed away on another mighty swing and missed

Lahiru Kumara to Razaullah, FOUR, cheeky and four, banged in short and at the stumps - Razaullah backs away, lets the ball come, opens the face of the bat and then runs it over the keeper's head for a boundary

Lahiru Kumara to Razaullah, FOUR, Razaullah is on fire now - full-toss outside off, he backs away, opens the face of the bat and then carves the drive in front of square on the off-side. The boundaries keep coming and Pakistan's lead keeps swelling
Milan Rathnayake to Ghazi Ghori, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Milan Rathnayake to Ghazi Ghori, out Caught by Kusal Mendis!! An ugly slog and Ghori has thrown his wicket away - on a good length and angling back into the right-hander, Ghori backed away on the big swing, gets a thin edge and Kusal Mendis does the rest. Dives to his left and pouches a clean catch. Ghazi Ghori c Kusal Mendis b Milan Rathnayake 54(90) [4s-4]
Mohammad Abbas, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Milan Rathnayake to Abbas, no run, on a good length and at the stumps, defended back at the bowler
Milan Rathnayake to Abbas, 1 run, tad fuller and at the stumps - Abbas stabs at that and finds the gap wide of gully, off the mark with a single
Milan Rathnayake to Razaullah, no run, slower ball outside off - Razaullah swipes across the line and misses
Milan Rathnayake to Razaullah, no run, another slower bouncer from Rathnayake - Razaullah ducks under and lets it go

Milan Rathnayake to Razaullah, no run, the slower bouncer from Rathnayake, dug into the pitch and it never came onto the right-hander - Razaullah backed away on the swat, had to wait and wait and doesn't connect
Lahiru Kumara to Abbas, 1 run, shortish ball, pulled away to deep backward square leg off the inner edge by Abbas who backs away

Lahiru Kumara to Razaullah, no run, almost a wicket! Slower ball, Razaullah gets down for a wild swing across the line. Early into the shot and misses it completely. Fortunately for the batter, the ball misses the leg-stump
Lahiru Kumara to Razaullah, no run, slow and well wide of off, cut to deep backward point and the batters don't take the single
Lahiru Kumara to Razaullah, SIX, that sounds good! Leg-cutter, full and in the slot, Razaullah moves leg-side, gets down on one leg and slogs it over deep midwicket. He absolutely nailed it
Lahiru Kumara to Razaullah, THATS OUT!! Bowled!!

Lahiru Kumara to Razaullah, out Bowled!! Timber! Fifer for Lahiru Kumara! Pace on, short of a good length ball at 134.5kph, Razaullah clears his front leg for a massive heave. Gets beaten on the inside edge and the ball crashes into the top of middle. Razaullah b Lahiru Kumara 42(32) [4s-4 6s-3]

14:18 Local Time, 09:18 GMT, 14:48 IST | Tea, day two: Pakistan take a lead of 227 runs after bowling out Sri Lanka for 98. Plenty of starts and just like the first Test, none of them converted them into triple-digits. They scored 100 runs for the loss of 4 wickets in the morning session. Ghazi Ghori scored a fifty and then Razaullah swung his bat for a quickfire 42 to take the lead over 200. For Sri Lanka, Lahiru Kumara bowled with a lot of heart and deservedly picked a fifer.
